use_case_summary: In-app product assistant + doc reranker for knowledge base and release notes search; must serve internal users and end customers with strict latency SLOs and data isolation.
canary_plan_summary: Canary config: start at 10% traffic to Dedicated canary pool (2 nodes), escalate to 30% after 48h if error rate <0.5% and 95th pct latency <300ms. Model variants: canary runs quantized 'redwood-70b-q4' and a smaller 'redwood-13b-int8' as baseline. Fallback routing: on error spike or latency breach, traffic auto-fails to hosted_api small-model (us-east-1). Region failover: primary us-east-1, fallback eu-west-1 for regional outages; routing policy keeps customer data residency controls in mind. Rollback: automatic on sustained errors >1% for 15m or manual rollback via console. SE to deliver canary playbook + rollback runbook before POC start.
pricing_notes: AE presented reserved capacity options: monthly commit for Dedicated with burst credits; addendum pending for canary + incremental instance hours. Estimated first-year ARR ~$120k mid-case. Finance requested itemized token-level estimate vs hosted for 3 workload profiles.
